name: Lotte (Germany)
description: White field charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Lotte (an anchor, a wavy bend and a heart on red), with red cloud-cut figures along the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Lotte; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Lotte arms — anchor, wavy bend and heart on red
